symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window: 6 orders stuck PAYMENT_PENDING with order-service PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE HttpTimeoutException calling payment-service /payments (D17-D19, D37, D50). Payment-service reports 12 requests received and answered 201, latency max 1.362s (D27) and gateway-mock /authorize max 1.355s (D33) with 10.002s max point, so the slowness sits downstream at gateway-mock, which answers slowly without errors.
